changes.text: The status stays complete, but the record's notes and its earlier change entry no longer say the paseo was built on the strength of the 2019 Phase 1 submittal, which was only a forecast. They now cite the Port Commission's Feb 11, 2025 minutes (staff's request to accept Phase 1's public infrastructure, including the paseos around Building G) and the Port's June 2026 report (Phase 1 completed in 2025; the City has accepted all Phase 1 public infrastructure); neither names this paseo individually. The Jan 30, 2018 Design Controls approval milestone now cites the Sept 2019 Port memo that states the date, and notes that the memo numbers that resolution 18-05 while the January 26 staff report requested it as 18-04.

record.notes: Bridgeview Street paseo (Bridgeview Way, north segment) -- the pedestrian paseo between Block G/Visa and Block K, from Exposition Street (Toni Stone Crossing) to China Basin Park; Design Controls Figure 3.1.1 marks it as Paseo 4.4. Built with Phase 1, per Port records of its acceptance: the 2019 Phase 1 submittal only planned it (Phase 1 'will also complete the Shared Public Way and Bridgeview Street paseos north of Exposition Street'), but the Port Commission's Feb 11, 2025 minutes record staff's request to accept Phase 1's public infrastructure and describe 'the paseos in the bottom around Building G leading in to China Basin Park' as Port owned (Resolutions 25-05, 25-06), and the Port's June 5, 2026 report says Phase 1 was completed in 2025 and 'The City has accepted all Phase 1 public infrastructure'. None of these names this paseo on its own. Its own real Assessor lot, 8719A007 (840 m2, addressed 1044 Bridgeview Way, recorded 2020-06-12); DataSF centerline CNN 15284000 (Bridgeview Way, END: NORTH to Toni Stone Xing, layer PRIVATE). Its east lot line is Block K's west edge. Added 2026-09-17.
